scope: Compose exact accepted primitives into an evidence-only supervisor channel. New source is based on receiver head, imports two accepted implementations byte-for-byte, adds channel implementation/test/scope. Frozen dependencies and V2 remain untouched.
authentication_model: Dedicated 32-byte HMAC-SHA256 key provisioned out of band to trusted receiver and trusted supervisor only, never worker or wire. MAC validity proves possession of that provisioned shared key; symmetric authentication is not a signature or nonrepudiation. Supervisor identity is fixed receiver configuration, not an identity chosen by a frame. Provisioning, isolation, rotation, destruction and actual deployment key custody remain unqualified.
bindings: Receiver computes process digest from independently supplied expected process document after sampling its owned pidfd/socket. Receiver creates channel digest from protocol/supervisor/receiver/process and fresh random nonce. Context additionally binds complete fresh receiver launch/challenge/chain/bindings. Source/tree/runtime/policy originate in trusted receiver configuration, never receiving observations.
implemented: Domain-separated HMAC envelopes for hello, event, acknowledgement and anchor
Strict bounded canonical JSON plus fixed network-order length, deadline, EOF/truncation/oversize rejection
Owned fixed socket/pidfd with accepted peer sampling before hello, before/after each receive and before export
MAC verification before forwarding event to receiver; failure and transport/durability uncertainty disable continuation/export
Receiver durable transition before authenticated ACK, which binds exact received message digest
One-time terminal receiver-owned transcript snapshot, grammar validation and MAC-authenticated anchor export
Verify anchor MAC against independently retained context/key before accepted transcript-integrity verification
qualification: 34 synthetic non-corpus methods: 31 real tiny post-exec Python relay integration methods and 3 pure framing methods. Relay uses a public test-only key. No JVM, real VM guard, experimental worker or official input. Local pure framing only; prior known AF_UNIX restriction is not retried. Pinned Actions supplies integration platform.
limits: No actual supervisor provisioning service or production keys deployed
Process sampling and MAC possession do not prove current descriptor holder, continuous lifetime identity, later-exec resistance, key non-exfiltration or complete authenticated VM event origin
No confidentiality: protocol is local authenticated evidence, not encrypted transport
Trusted receiver and supervisor can both compute MACs; neither is adversarial in this threat model
Exported anchors have cryptographic integrity but no external rollback-resistant durable witness or durable one-time consumption; replay of an export is outside this stateless verifier
A consumed transcript without successful ACK/export remains unusable through this adapter; no restart/reissue API
The adapter uses accepted receiver private directory descriptor for the single transcript snapshot; this interface composition is a review obligation

Canonical manifest, VM entry paths, hidden generator inputs, derivative build, immutable deployment/platform/kernel/supply chain, full admission, prepared worker, sealed launch and R1 permit remain open
No network-peer identity is promoted to authenticated class definition provenance; hidden families remain refused because substrate is absent
review_requested: Independent Reviewer B source/integration/authenticated-evidence-channel review only. No self-adoption, sealed launch or gameplay authority.
